SessionCreate.description: Starts a focus session. clientStartedAt is clamped to [serverNow - 24 h, serverNow + 2 min]; the clamp is recorded so offline replay is exactly-once but observable.

clientStartedAt.description: Device clock at session start. The server accepts it within [serverNow - 24 h, serverNow + 2 min] and clamps values outside that window, recording the clamp.

SessionEventRequest.description: Session event with its client timestamp. Clamping rules are [session.startedAt, serverNow + 2 min] plus per-session monotonicity; clamped values are recorded.

clientAt.description: Device clock at the event. Accepted within [session.startedAt, serverNow + 2 min] and monotonic per session; out-of-range or out-of-order values are clamped to the nearest bound and the clamp is recorded.

TodayProposal.description: Persisted shrink/reschedule proposal with its base plan version and availability snapshot. Approval re-validates availability atomically (08 §2.4).

post.description: Reuses the plan-approval atomicity contract (08 §2.4): If-Match is the user-wide availability version W/"availability:<n>", and one transaction re-reads availability and locked blocks, re-runs validation, supersedes prior blocks and creates a plan version with createdBy="replan". A stale snapshot returns 412 availability_changed, a non-pending proposal returns 409 proposal_state_conflict, and scheduler findings return 422 constraint_violation{violations[]}.

post.description: Creates a pending proposal for a plan with trigger kind user_request. When the same reason is inside its 24 h post-rejection suppression window, or the owner already received two proposals today, the response is 409 replan_suppressed with Retry-After seconds until the next allowed attempt.

get.description: The range must be positive and at most 366 days (422 validation_failed otherwise). Only non-superseded approved blocks of the owner are returned.
get.summary: List active approved blocks overlapping a calendar range (FU-51)

post.description: If-Match is the block version W/"<ScheduleBlock.version>". Only a planned block of an active plan that has not started yet (startAt >= now) can be locked or unlocked; a started, done, skipped, moved or superseded block (or a block of a non-active plan) is 409 illegal_transition. The block times never change. A change increments the block version and the plan revision (Plan.version = Today.version), so Today actions, plan previews and Today proposals pinned to the previous revision answer 412/409 and must be refreshed. Repeating the call on a block that already has the requested state returns it unchanged. Unknown or foreign blocks are 404. A locked block is kept as-is by replan, regenerate and Today actions (06 §7).
post.summary: Lock an approved future block so replanning never moves it (FU-71)

post.description: If-Match is the block version W/"<ScheduleBlock.version>". The block times never change. A change increments the block version and the plan revision (Plan.version = Today.version), so Today actions, plan previews and Today proposals pinned to the previous revision answer 412/409 and must be refreshed. Repeating the call on a block that already has the requested state returns it unchanged. Unknown or foreign blocks are 404. An unlocked block is movable by the next replan.
